def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Rectangular outlines encode a filled rectangle; color 6's cavity maps to 2,
    # while the other outlined shapes map to 7.
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            col=g[r][c]
            if col in (3,6): # 3 may be a frame too; retain below via test of actual rectangle
                pass
            # Consider every solid rectangular border of at least 3x3.
            for r2 in range(r+2,R):
                if g[r2][c] != col: continue
                for c2 in range(c+2,C):
                    if g[r][c2]!=col or g[r2][c2]!=col: continue
                    if all(g[r][x]==col and g[r2][x]==col for x in range(c,c2+1)) and all(g[y][c]==col and g[y][c2]==col for y in range(r,r2+1)):
                        fill=2 if col==6 else 7
                        for y in range(r+1,r2):
                            for x in range(c+1,c2):
                                if g[y][x]!=col: g[y][x]=fill

    # Small 3x3 outlined symbols have a one-cell center cavity.
    for r in range(1,R-1):

                g[r][c]=7
    return g
